scope: In-source notices of futures-channel 0.3.34 and crypto-primes 0.7.2 (Windows, macOS and Android selections) whose terms ask for the notice to be kept, and which the selected LICENSE-MIT does not carry; whether they are delivered and in which form. Not final application compliance or installer delivery.
basis: docs/release/license-crypto-bigint-notices-2026-11-05.json (other_crates: heuristic candidates; these two carry an explicit condition to keep the notice)

notice.condition: BSD-2-Clause-style header: "Redistributions in binary form must reproduce the above copyright notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer in the documentation and/or other materials provided with the distribution."
notice.text_first_line: /* Copyright (c) 2010-2011 Dmitry Vyukov. All rights reserved.

crates.reachability: src/mpsc/queue.rs backs futures-channel's mpsc channels, compiled with the std feature that futures-util enables; whether its code survives linking is not claimed.

output.check: The quoted block equals the named line range of the archive file byte for byte.

notice.holder: Sun Microsystems, Inc. (fdlibm, via FreeBSD msun e_log2.c)
notice.condition: fdlibm notice: "Permission to use, copy, modify, and distribute this software is freely granted, provided that this notice is preserved."

crates.reachability: src/hazmat/libm.rs holds the log2 function crypto-primes extracted from libm; whether its code survives linking is not claimed.

output.check: The quoted block equals the named line range of the archive file byte for byte.

decision: Both packages keep MIT and their LICENSE-MIT and additionally deliver the quoted notice blocks verbatim in <package>-<version>-SOURCE-NOTICES.txt, in all three selections (the selection policy retains associated copyright and source notices; pattern: crypto-bigint-0.7.10-SOURCE-NOTICES.txt). No separate BSD-2-Clause text is added: the quoted futures-channel header is itself the complete license notice of that file.
remaining: The other candidates of the crypto-bigint report (polyval, uuid, muda, curve25519-dalek, cpubits, der, toml, tauri) carry attribution lines without a condition to reproduce them; they stay undecided.
